 Order

This is the first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant/accused under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail, as he is under apprehension of his arrest, in connection with Crime No.30/2024, registered at Police Station Budhni District Sehore (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n) of the IPC.
2. As per prosecution story, prosecutrix and applicant were in love relationship.
They both have decided to marry each other.
On 25th March 2021, at around 12 am, present applicant called her at his room and committed offence.
Thereafter, applicant has left her to Gujrat and said that if she will leave her job, he will marry her.
Prosecutrix left the job and thereafter present applicant denied marrying her.
On the FIR of the prosecutrix, Police registered the aforesaid offence against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely implicated in the present case.
Prosecutrix is a major lady and was a consenting party.
They were in love relationship.
He has drawn attention of this Court to Annexure-A/2 in which prosecutrix has Govinda Gorele vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 February, 2024

4. Learned counsel for the objector has stated that the applicant is ready to marry her therefore, he has no objection if the applicant is granted anticipatory bail.
5 . Learned Panel Lawyer appearing for the State opposed the bail application.
6. Considering the aforesaid circumstances of the case, anticipatory bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that in the event of arrest of applicant in connection with the aforesaid crime number and the offences, she be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/Arresting Authority.

She will further abide by the condition enumerated in sub-section (2) of Section 438 of the Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.
